overview.title: Tax and accounting work for individuals, families and businesses.
overview.text: Pick a service to see what it covers, or call the office and talk it through with our team.

services.title: Individual Tax Returns
services.summary: Preparation and planning for personal returns.
services.text: Preparation and planning for individual returns, including help understanding recent tax changes and resolving other tax issues you might have.
services.lead: Hollis Lewis prepares and files individual returns for clients in Houston, The Woodlands and the surrounding areas, and plans ahead for the year to come.

covers.title: Return preparation
covers.text: Your individual return prepared and filed for the year.

covers.title: Tax planning
covers.text: Planning through the year rather than only at filing time.

covers.title: Recent tax changes
covers.text: An explanation of the tax changes that affect your return.

covers.title: Other tax issues
covers.text: Help resolving other tax issues you might have.

services.title: Estate & Trust Returns
services.text: Tax preparation and planning for estates and trusts, handled by the same firm that prepares the family's individual returns.
services.lead: Estates and trusts file their own returns. Hollis Lewis prepares them alongside the individual returns of the people involved.

covers.title: Estate returns
covers.text: Preparation and filing of the estate's own tax return.

covers.title: Trust returns
covers.text: Annual returns for trusts the family has set up.

covers.title: Planning
covers.text: Tax planning for the years ahead, not just the year being filed.

services.title: Gift Tax Returns
services.text: Gift tax returns prepared and filed, with planning for gifts made during the year and the ones being considered.
services.lead: A gift above the annual limit has to be reported. Hollis Lewis prepares the return and plans the timing of what comes next.

covers.title: Return preparation
covers.text: The gift tax return prepared and filed for the year.

covers.title: Planning
covers.text: A look at gifts being considered before they are made.

services.title: Business Tax Returns
services.text: Tax preparation and planning for partnerships, S-corporations and corporations, with the recent tax changes explained as they land.
services.lead: Hollis Lewis prepares business returns for partnerships, S-corporations and corporations, and plans the year so the filing holds no surprises.

covers.title: Business partnership
covers.text: Partnership returns and the schedules the partners need.

covers.title: S-corp
covers.text: Returns for S-corporations and their shareholders.

covers.title: Corporate
covers.text: Corporate tax returns prepared and filed.

covers.title: Tax planning
covers.text: Planning the year's position rather than reporting it afterwards.

services.title: Non-Profit Returns
services.text: Tax preparation and planning for non-profit organizations, filed on the schedule the organization has to keep.
services.lead: Non-profit organizations file annual returns of their own. Hollis Lewis prepares them and plans for the year ahead.

covers.title: Annual return
covers.text: The organization's yearly return prepared and filed.

covers.title: Planning
covers.text: Tax planning for the organization through the year.

services.title: Small Business Accounting
services.text: Small business accounting, payroll and cash flow management for small and medium sized businesses, including 1099 preparation.
services.lead: The firm offers a wide range of business services to small and medium sized businesses, from the monthly books through to payroll and the year's 1099s.

covers.title: Small business accounting
covers.text: The books kept for small and medium sized businesses.

covers.title: Payroll
covers.text: Payroll run for your employees.

covers.title: Cash flow management
covers.text: A view of the money coming in and going out.

covers.title: 1099 preparation
covers.text: The 1099s your business has to issue, prepared and filed.

services.title: QuickBooks Support
services.summary: QuickBooks help for your own books.
services.text: QuickBooks support for businesses that keep their own books, so the file the firm works from is the one you use every day.
services.lead: Hollis Lewis works in QuickBooks with businesses that keep their own records, so the accounting and the tax work start from the same file.

covers.title: Setup
covers.text: The file set up for the way your business works.

covers.title: Ongoing support
covers.text: Questions answered as they come up through the year.

services.title: Business Consulting
services.text: Business consulting for small and medium sized businesses, covering new business formation and succession planning.
services.lead: Starting a business and handing one on are both decisions with tax attached. Hollis Lewis works through them with the owner.
services.imageAlt: Two people going over figures on a laptop at a meeting table

covers.title: New business formation
covers.text: Help setting up the business and choosing how it is structured.

covers.title: Succession planning
covers.text: Planning the handover of a business to the next owner.

services.title: Cost Segregation Studies
services.summary: Cost segregation on property you own.
services.text: Cost segregation studies for business property, separating out the parts of a building that are written off over a shorter life.
services.lead: A building is not one single asset for tax purposes. A cost segregation study separates out the parts that depreciate faster.

covers.title: The study
covers.text: The property's costs separated into their depreciation lives.

covers.title: The return
covers.text: The result carried through to the business return the firm prepares.

services.title: Research & Development Credits
services.summary: R&D credits claimed on your return.
services.text: Research and development credits worked out and claimed for businesses whose work qualifies for them.
services.lead: Businesses that develop or improve products and processes may qualify for research and development credits. Hollis Lewis works out the claim and files it.

covers.title: Qualifying work
covers.text: A look at which of your activities count towards the credit.

covers.title: The claim
covers.text: The credit calculated and claimed on the business return.

about.title: A tax and accounting practice since 1947.
text: Hollis Lewis & Company PLLC was founded in 1947 by Fox H. Hollis, Jr. to provide tax and accounting services to the Southeast Harris County, Texas area. Mark E. Hollis joined the firm in 1977 as the practice expanded to include the Houston area.

Gordon A. Lewis merged his Woodlands accounting practice into the Hollis firm in 2002, creating Hollis Lewis & Company PLLC. Together Mark and Gordon have over 90 years of experience providing tax and accounting services.
